chunks: Therefore, follow the one who followed His Prophet, tread in his footsteps, and enter through his entrance,

Otherwise, he will not be safe from ruin. Certainly, Allah (Exalted and Majestic) made Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) a sign for the Hour, a bringer of glad tidings of Paradise, and a warner of retribution.
He left this world hungry, and entered the Hereafter safe. He did not lay one stone upon another, until he departed and answered the call of his Lord,
How great is Allah's blessing upon us when He bestowed upon us Him as a predecessor whom we follow, and a leader behind whom we tread.

key_terms.خَمِيصًا: Hungry or barefoot (lacking provisions or shoes)
key_terms.عَلَمًا لِلسَّاعَةِ: A sign for the Hour (Day of Judgement)

ai.seo_question: What are the key signs of the Prophet's readiness for death and his role as a guide according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This passage from Nahj al-Balagha underscores the necessity of emulating the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him) asceticism and spiritual readiness, noting that he departed the world with no accumulated wealth, thereby validating his divine mission. It frames his life as the definitive sign of the Hour and a dual promise of Paradise and warning, urging believers to view his example as a practical guide for salvation. In Shia tradition, this emphasis on his poverty (faqr) and purity (salamah) reinforces the concept of the Prophet as the perfect human (al-Insan al-Kamil) whose life is the ultimate criterion for following the path to God.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Therefore, one should follow His Prophet, tread in his footsteps and enter through his entrance.

Otherwise he will not be safe from ruin. Certainly, Allāh made Muḥammad — the peace and blessing of Allāh be upon him and his descendants — a sign for the Day of Judgement, a conveyor of tidings for Paradise and a warner of retribution.
He left this world hungry but entered upon the next world safe. He did not lay one stone upon another (to make a house) till he departed and responded to the call of Allāh.
How great is Allāh’s blessing in that He blessed us with the Prophet as a predecessor whom we follow and a leader behind whom we tread.
